requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer (Magellan) specifically targeting unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs (5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, AMPV ~500 pages) without dedicated IT teams.
requirements.Rationale: Address a gap in HP's portfolio for SMBs seeking ROI, efficiency, and low TCO, and to compete in the CISS PLE Hi segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A business ink tank printer is developed and launched, available for SMB customers, with documented targeting and positioning for the unmanaged/lightly managed SMB segment.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate best-in-class AI solutions for productivity, scan workflow, and printer manageability, focused on SMB ease-of-use and future-proofing.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy management and productivity tools due to lack of IT resources; AI-driven features are a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product includes AI-driven features for print and scan workflows, and manageability, validated through user testing with SMBs.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP's lowest business TCO with minimal intervention required from users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value cost efficiency and minimal maintenance; TCO is a major purchase driver.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis demonstrates that Magellan has the lowest business TCO in HP's portfolio for SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan achieves at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP) in its construction, exceeding key competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a top customer priority and a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product BOM and third-party verification confirm 60%+ RCP in all applicable plastic parts.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by the customer, with service center (MINK) backup if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizing downtime and simplifying maintenance is critical for SMBs without IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field testing shows that over 95% of customers can replace the maintenance box without technical support.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles to prevent incorrect ink refilling and ensure user-friendly, error-proof operation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user errors and support calls, enhancing SMB experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are implemented and testing shows zero cross-contamination in user trials.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated SMB portal for managing printers, targeting non-IT users for easy fleet management.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need simple, centralized device management due to lack of IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB, AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available at launch, usability tested with SMB office managers and generalist IT users, and meets satisfaction benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry features for monitoring device health, usage, and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry enables predictive maintenance, lower support costs, and better product insights for HP and customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB, SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry system collects and reports device health, usage, and error data to HP and users, with data privacy compliance.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP's PaaS offerings, including integration with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS is a strategic direction for HP and a requirement for future SMB offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan is compatible with HP's PaaS solutions and passes integration tests with SMB2.0 and Advanced View.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support for Specific SKUs
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, Magellan must support PDL/PS and achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved over current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: PDL/PS support and improved speed are required for certain business workflows and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs achieve specified print speeds in independent testing and support PDL/PS as documented.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan PDL SKU achieves Blue Angel environmental certification.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are important for business customers and certain geographies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing workflows through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is increasingly important for SMBs with hybrid workforces.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: HP App supports Magellan printers for mobile print workflows with successful user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: Maintenance Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to be maintenance free or require less maintenance (fewer parts to replace over product life).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces SMB user burden and increases uptime.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMB
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product design validated by engineering to require less maintenance than comparable models; field data supports lower maintenance rates.
